label: scaffold

definition.note: 72h means one continuous monotonic wall_elapsed_s >= 259200 with max_wall_seconds 259200 on a single live soak process. A sum of ended SHORT walls is not that wall. Stitching sequential or restarted invocations is not that wall, even when the stitched duration or calendar span reaches 259200. A wall that resets or goes backwards is not that wall. cycles x interval is not the wall. cycles_exit0 is process success only. The Issue #9 conditional approval is not a start. LOCAL_ONLY evidence does not count. Unknown root cause is not a terminal attribution. A soak-DUT stall watchdog is not a watchdog of the supervisor. An offline synthetic supervisor probe is not that watchdog, does not satisfy founder condition 2, and is not a start. A dummy-process exercise of scripts/supervisor_watchdog.py is not that watchdog, does not demonstrate a supervision write every 10 minutes, and does not satisfy founder condition 2. A time-compressed exercise of scripts/supervision_cadence.py can write on a short interval. That exercise does not demonstrate a supervision write every 10 minutes and does not satisfy founder condition 2. A write later than 600 seconds does not meet the cadence bound. A sample classification from scripts/failure_attribution.py does not attribute a live soak failure and does not satisfy founder condition 4. A sample public pack from scripts/public_evidence_pack.py does not pack live soak evidence and does not satisfy founder condition 3. LOCAL_ONLY does not count. docs/progress/l2_2/SHA256SUMS.json is not that pack. A 72h result is not production readiness.

supervisor_watchdog_honesty.note: This offline probe classifies synthetic temp files only. It does not satisfy founder condition 2. It is not a supervisor watchdog of a live supervisor. It is not a start. scripts/stall_watchdog.py watches a soak DUT and is not this watchdog.

supervisor_watchdog_implementation.note: Implementation exists and dummy crash-within-10s tests passed. Dummy-process success is not a live L2-2 supervisor watchdog, does not demonstrate the 10-minute supervision write cadence, and does not satisfy founder condition 2.

supervision_cadence_writer.note: Implementation exists and a time-compressed offline exercise wrote supervision records on its short interval. That exercise is not a live started L2-2 supervisor, does not demonstrate a real supervision write at least once every 10 minutes, and does not satisfy founder condition 2. A write later than 600 seconds does not meet the cadence bound. scripts/stall_watchdog.py and scripts/supervisor_watchdog.py are not this writer.

failure_attribution.note: This module classifies sample attribution records only. Accepted terminal classes are business, host, and supervision. Unknown, empty, missing, and other free-text labels are rejected. A record that names more than one class without a single terminal class is rejected. Classifying these samples does not attribute a live soak failure, does not satisfy founder condition 4, and does not start L2-2.

public_evidence_pack.note: This module validates sample public-shaped packs only. A sample pack needs publication public plus final metrics, a log summary, and a SHA list. Digests are SHA-256 from scripts/evidence_sha256sums.py. LOCAL_ONLY is refused and does not count. A pack missing any of the three pieces is refused. docs/progress/l2_2/SHA256SUMS.json binds scaffold bytes only and is not live soak evidence. Validating these samples does not satisfy founder condition 3 and does not start L2-2.

gates.close_policy: This tool never accepts L2-2 and never starts the 72h clock. A later explicit non-Interactive run can be reviewed by the observation track. Production 7x24 stays NOT ACCEPTED. Interactive console scheduled tasks stay out of scope.

next_steps: Leave the 2026-11-03..06 L2-4 reconstruction on PR #11. Do not re-capture that window to start L2-2.
Do not register, create, or enable Interactive console scheduled tasks. That is a founder major gate and is not approved by this scaffold.
Keep the 72h clock NOT STARTED until a founder or worker explicitly decides to start the existing non-Interactive local soak.

Before that start, fill docs/progress/l2_2/R2_CHECKLIST.md. Watch the live soak summary.jsonl while soak_2h.py is the DUT (runner-*.json only when the DUT is L1 with no soak). scripts/coverage_gap_log.py appends timestamp, gap_seconds, band (ok below 13s, yellow 13s through 5min, red above 5min), and source. Yellow is not a business FAIL. A gap line does not start the clock or complete the soak.

Only after that explicit start decision, on a host already allowed to run the local soak: PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/soak_2h.py --cycles 5000 --interval 60 --via-l1 --seed 300 --idle-policy reseed --max-wall-seconds 259200
Cycles must be large enough that max-wall stops the process. cycles x interval is not the wall. cycles_exit0 is not business progress. A 86400s wall is not this 72h gate.
Historical SHORT walls are not additive. Ubuntu-24H 86400.001s plus another 86400s, or 86400s times 3, is not one continuous monotonic wall and is not this 72h gate.

Sequential or restarted soak invocations are not one live process. A back-to-back pair of 86400s soaks, three sequential 86400s soaks covering 72h of calendar time, or a wall that resets or goes backwards, is not this 72h gate.
After a real run, score the bundle with scripts/l2_2_score.py. Expect INCOMPLETE. This tool will not emit PASS or accept production 7x24.
An R3 injection receipt is required before any supervision-verified tag. The observation track accepts or rejects. This scorer does not.

Product L2 (self-decompose / self-implement) is CONDITIONAL on the observation track, not granted, pending one end-to-end T3: a new goal and a new schema, the product derives the task set, then executes and delivers, with no handwritten dispatch. T2 DS-T2-20261110 is ACCEPTED (Issue #9 comment 6765608469, 2026-11-10T11:00:40Z, evidence PR #13 tip 9cac002). Comment 6767990189 (2026-11-10T13:00:44Z) accepted the PR #14 tip 738b47a derivation evidence and left L2 CONDITIONAL. No task_inbox/DS-T3 card is on main. PR #15 tip a07ec9f prepared that path with a local demo fixture and is not a T3 run and not acceptance. This scorer does not run T3, does not rerun T1 or T2, and does not grant product L2. L2-3 mid-run kill recovery is a separate gate.

Issue #9 comment 6761044915 (2026-11-10T06:50:14Z) is a conditional founder approval for PR #12. That approval is not a start, not a PASS, and it does not set can_start_clock. The five conditions stay unsatisfied until a later explicit declaration: supervision policy (yellow 13s through 300s, red above 300s, monotonic clock), supervision writes at least once every 10 minutes and a separate process records a supervisor crash within 10s (the soak-DUT stall watchdog is not that watchdog; an offline synthetic supervisor-alive versus supervisor-crash-unrecorded probe is not that watchdog either and does not satisfy condition 2), public evidence of final metrics plus a log summary plus a SHA list (LOCAL_ONLY does not count), three-way failure attribution (business, host, supervision; unknown root cause is not a terminal attribution), and no production 7x24 claim. A 72h result is not production readiness. This scorer does not post the L2-2 START line.

scripts/supervisor_watchdog.py can watch a pid and write a crash record within 10 seconds. Offline dummy-process tests are not a live L2-2 supervisor watchdog, do not demonstrate a supervision write every 10 minutes, and do not satisfy founder condition 2. The synthetic-file probe and scripts/stall_watchdog.py do not satisfy it either. A report that treats the scaffold, the dummy tests, the synthetic probe, or the stall hook as condition 2, PASS, started, ACCEPTED, or production 7x24 fails closed.

scripts/supervision_cadence.py writes supervision records on a configured interval. The intended production bound is at most 600 seconds. The offline exercise uses a short time-compressed interval. Writes on that short schedule do not demonstrate a supervision write at least once every 10 minutes and do not satisfy founder condition 2. A write later than 600 seconds does not meet the cadence bound. scripts/stall_watchdog.py and scripts/supervisor_watchdog.py are not this writer. A report that treats the short exercise as the 10-minute cadence, as condition 2, PASS, started, ACCEPTED, or production 7x24 fails closed.

scripts/failure_attribution.py classifies sample records into business, host, or supervision. Unknown, empty, missing, free-text, and multi-class labels are rejected. That sample classification does not attribute a live soak failure, does not satisfy founder condition 4, and is not a start. A report that treats it as condition 4, as a live soak attribution, PASS, started, ACCEPTED, or production 7x24 fails closed.

scripts/public_evidence_pack.py validates sample public-shaped packs only. A pack labeled sample/offline with publication public plus final metrics, a log summary, and a SHA list can validate. LOCAL_ONLY is refused and does not count. A pack missing any of the three pieces is refused. docs/progress/l2_2/SHA256SUMS.json binds scaffold bytes only and is not live soak evidence. That sample validation does not satisfy founder condition 3 and is not a start. A report that treats it as condition 3, as a live soak evidence pack, as permission to count LOCAL_ONLY, or as PASS, started, ACCEPTED, or production 7x24 fails closed.

Issue #9 comment 6776483825 (2026-11-10T19:00:37Z) recorded an observation-track acceptance of T3 and product L2, void if plan.json was handwritten to fool the check. This scorer does not re-claim that verdict, does not accept L2-2, and does not start the clock. Production 7x24 stays NOT ACCEPTED.
